## Overview
Adobe reported strong Q1 2024 results, achieving $5.18B in revenue (up 11% YoY) and an EPS of $4.48, beating estimates of $4.38. The quarter was highlighted by robust enterprise adoption of Firefly AI integration across the Creative Cloud suite.

## Key Takeaways
- Total revenue reached a record $5.18B, reflecting 11% YoY growth
- Digital Media segment revenue grew 12% YoY to $3.82B
- Document Cloud revenue increased 18% YoY to $750M
- RPO (Remaining Performance Obligations) reached $17.58B, providing strong forward visibility

## Highlights
- Firefly AI models surpassed 6.5 billion generations globally
- Acrobat AI Assistant saw rapid enterprise adoption, expanding document intelligence capabilities
- Achieved record cash flows from operations of $1.17B during the quarter

## Investment Focus Areas
- **Products**: Acrobat AI Assistant, Premiere Pro generative AI workflows, Adobe Express
- **AI & Cloud**: Scaling Firefly foundational models and expanding enterprise AI infrastructure
- **Strategic Priorities**: Monetizing generative AI across enterprise segments and expanding the Document Cloud ecosystem
